paper_title: BANGLAPLAN: A Benchmark for Constraint-Based Planning and Decision-Making in Bangla
reason: BANGLAPLAN은 벵골어(Bangla)로 직접 작성된 1,000문항 계획 수립·의사결정 벤치마크로, 평가 대상 과제 언어가 한국어도 영어도 아니라서 이 인벤토리의 ko/en 범위 밖이다. 논문은 모든 프롬프트를 Claude Sonnet 5.5로 영어로 번역해 일부 모델(GPT-6.1 Sol과 Qwen3.5 2B/4B/9B)에서 비교했다(3.1절, 4절). 하지만 이 영어판은 언어 효과를 분석하기 위한 보조 실험용 기계 번역본이다. 논문은 영어판을 별도 공개 자원이나 벤치마크 구성 요소로 제시하지 않으며 공식 저장소에 포함된다고 밝히지도 않았다. 따라서 영어 트랙에 독립 행으로 올릴 근거가 부족하다고 보고 제외한다.

screening.paper_title: BANGLAPLAN: A Benchmark for Constraint-Based Planning and Decision-Making in Bangla
screening.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly help users arrange appointments, plan journeys, and allocate limited resources. These tasks require models to satisfy constraints on time, cost, capacity, and order, or determine that no feasible solution exists. Bangla is the world's seventh most widely spoken language, and existing benchmarks cover many language and reasoning tasks. However, benchmarks for evaluating planning and decision-making in Bangla under explicit constraints remain lacking. We introduce BANGLAPLAN, a benchmark of 1,000 problems across ten task families grounded in everyday life and institutions in Bangladesh. It includes feasible and infeasible problems in four language registers: everyday, formal, colloquial, and Bangla--English mixed. Answers cover eight structured types, including schedules, routes, allocations, and ordered steps, in a common JSON format. We construct the benchmark through language-model-assisted drafting and independent human validation. We evaluate 11 open-weight and proprietary model configurations using exact match, separately reporting feasible-case accuracy, infeasibility detection, and format errors. We find a large performance gap: GPT-6.1 Sol achieves 98.7% accuracy and Qwen3.5-27B with thinking reaches 80.3%, while direct-answer configurations score at most 30.9%. Seven of eleven configurations perform below the always-``infeasible'' baseline. Our findings also suggest that harder problems primarily reduce plan-construction accuracy, while infeasibility detection remains more robust. BANGLAPLAN provides a reproducible basis for evaluating planning and decision-making in Bangla. BANGLAPLAN is available at: https://github.com/mrayhanulmasud/banglaplan.
